description: This file implements Windows registry key management functions, including creation, opening, deletion, enumeration, and reading registry values, with support for 32/64-bit registry views.

classes.name: RegKey
classes.description: A class encapsulating Windows registry key operations such as create, open, close, delete, and read.

classes.name: RegistryValueIterator
classes.description: An iterator class for enumerating registry values within a key.

classes.name: RegistryKeyIterator
classes.description: An iterator class for enumerating subkeys within a registry key.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates a registry key with specified access rights.

methods.name: CreateWithDisposition
methods.description: Creates a registry key with disposition information.

methods.name: OpenKey
methods.description: Opens a subkey relative to the current key.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Closes the current registry key handle.

methods.name: DeleteKey
methods.description: Deletes a subkey, with recursion if necessary.

methods.name: DeleteEmptyKey
methods.description: Deletes a subkey if it is empty.

methods.name: ReadValueDW
methods.description: Reads a DWORD value from the registry.

methods.name: ReadInt64
methods.description: Reads a 64-bit integer value from the registry.

methods.name: ReadValue
methods.description: Reads a string value from the registry.

methods.name: WriteValue
methods.description: Writes a value to the registry, supporting different data types.
